frozen._max_gross_stress_note: C4's OWN GROSS CAP (team lead 2026-10-26: 'its own gross cap'), DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN, by the frozen rule that set the core's 1.80 (PREREG_GROUP_CAP_2026-09-16 §3b, applied for Alpaca in PREREG_ALPACA_V7_2026-09-28 §3b, CEF trial 50): G_stress = (NLV - M_other)/(m + w5)/E_book, floored to 0.05 after subtracting the mark sensitivity. UNITS: a MULTIPLE of sleeve NAV, applied to gross = sum|w| of the HELD book after the band by one uniform f = cap/gross in (0,1); it only scales down and never flattens. INPUTS: NLV $100,000 and M_other $0 are RULINGS, not reads (C4's own $100k in its own account, team lead 2026-10-26; no broker is called in this step, and since 2026-10-28 the agent lab shares the account but holds nothing there yet); m = 0.50, Reg T initial, the core's ruled input (all 74 marginable at 30% maintenance at the frozen 2026-10-14T21:40:33Z read [V]); E_book $100,000 = capital_usd; w5 = 0.0261393, the worst 5-session total-return loss per unit gross held of C4's UNCAPPED 4.8% band on CRSP ret over its fit window 2005-02-22..2022-12-30, the five sessions ending 2008-07-23 (IGR, RQI and RNP held short and rising every day; a direct second computation agrees to 1e-12; next worst 0.0244 ending 2020-03-17 and 0.0242 ending 2009-04-08). The method first reproduces the core's recorded 13-name w5, 0.0425814 ending 2020-03-18, on panels cut at 2022-12-30. G_stress = 1.900638; no mark sensitivity (no other book's margin) -> floor_0.05 = 1.90. NOT CHOSEN: the core's 1.80 (copying it would size 74 other funds to the 13's worst week), 1.9006 itself (no room for its own movement), and no cap (the uncapped band reaches 3.20x and is above 1.90x on 34.1% of fit sessions). PLATEAU (fit gross SR; the value comes from the arithmetic, not from this): 1.60 1.247, 1.70 1.233, 1.80 1.217, 1.90 1.200, 2.00 1.185, none 1.137, a slope with no cliff. TEAM LEAD, 2026-10-29 (answered interactively), four rulings. (1) KEEP 1.90, the re-derived value, NOT the trial's 1.80. Paper therefore trades a book the trial did not test exactly: fit gross SR 1.200 total return / 1.344 price-only at 1.90, against the trial's 1.217 / 1.360 at 1.80 (results/cef/c4/c4_paper_benchmark_2026-10-29.txt §4). H11's 120-session percentile and the drawdown stop read THIS 1.90 book (scripts/cef/c4_paper_benchmark.py h11_reference, H11_BOOK = spec_book), never the trial's. THIN HEADROOM, accepted knowingly: a worst week above w5 = 0.02632 (0.0263158) gives 1.85, and the fit's sits 0.0001765 below it; w5 is the fit window only, where the core's read ran to its panel end, and C4's 2023-26 returns are not read. (2) COUNTING: adopting this re-derived cap does NOT count as a CEF trial, because it applies a frozen rule with no performance test; the CEF counter stays 52 (docs/RESEARCH_STATE.md, CEF notes, 2026-10-29). That differs from the trial-50 precedent, where adopting max_gross_stress on the core book, re-derived for the Alpaca account and the 13, was counted (PREREG_ALPACA_V7_2026-09-28, trial 2 of two). (3) ARMING GATE: before C4 is armed (plan §2 step 6), this key is re-derived by this rule from a fresh read of the account's NLV and of the other book's margin as M_other (the agent lab shares the account since 2026-10-28), with that book's mark sensitivity; C4 arms only on the re-derived value (a changed value is a new spec id). (4) The halve/kill drawdown levels are left for step 5's book json (superseded 2026-10-30: the core's levels in report mode, risk._halve_drawdown_note, from c4_families.v3.20261102). Also declared: while below_min_names = hold lasts the cap is effectively off (step 1).
